defects_fixed.after: Added PATIENT_REQUESTS, CHEN_REQUEST, PAYER_REQUIREMENTS_72148, PORTFOLIO_METRICS and JOHNSON_DENIAL and seven read-only operations (PA-05 to PA-11).
